question: 'Loo' winds are usually associated with ______ in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**summer seasons**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Loo' winds** are characterized by their hot and dry nature.
 
• These winds typically blow in the **northern plains of India** during the **summer season**.
 
• The temperature associated with Loo winds can rise drastically, sometimes reaching up to **45°C to 50°C**.
 
• They usually occur during the months of **May and June** when the summer is at its peak.
 
• These winds can cause severe dehydration and heat strokes if proper precautions are not taken.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **summer season** in India is generally from **March to June**.
 
• During this period, temperatures soar, especially in the northern and northwestern parts of India.
 
• The presence of Loo winds is a common phenomenon in states like **Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• To combat the effects of Loo winds, it is advised to stay hydrated and avoid direct exposure to the sun during peak hours.
